name: Master Chain Situations and Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Starting points for Master Chain for mixing down and mastering in many music styles and situations: club, festival, big room, home hi-fi, headphones, studio reference, radio and car, plus 32 music styles for streaming. The Situations folder uses a common style for each situation (house for club, EDM for festival and big room, pop for home, headphones, radio, car and streaming, transparent for studio). Target character, target loudness, ceiling, tone and ratio follow the Master Director recipes; every preset also sets its own pre-limiter gain, threshold, attack, release, knee, make-up and compressor mix (fast and tight for hardstyle and techno, slow and light for classical, ambient and jazz), with the make-up tuned so the level does not drop. The target character also shapes the compressor (warm softer and slower, firm and club tighter), and the limiter now holds the ceiling you set; the threshold of every preset is tuned for the same average reduction as before. The soft styles (folk, jazz, classical, soundtrack, ambient) get a little tone colour of their own on top of that. Tone and compression switch off when a preset would leave them at zero.
